summary: Completed backend + frontend testing of LINQ Command Center & FrasbergAI Realtime Core. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests passed (LiveKit token minting real JWT, room lifecycle upsert/list/get/end, events with viewerCount increment, tip validation, leads, luchii AI viewer_question reply, preview state ObjectId-free, LINQ 45 layers with roman I..XLV & foundation/ascension tiers, overview counts, layer run generating AI artifacts, threat + compliance engine runs with tag/narrative/cognition/score/recommendations, billing engine history, unauthenticated 401 gate). Frontend: /linq unauth gate, login via /auth (had to click auth-toggle-mode to switch from Register->Login), /linq authed showed linq-page, linq-overview-stats, ascension-ladder with 45 layer buttons; run-layer-1 produced layer-artifact-1 with rich narrative; Threat tab run produced engine-threat-latest card (tag + score 62/100); LINQ Live tab exposed linq-live/live-now-strip/preview-panel/ask-luchii-input/ask-luchii-btn/chat-messages; Ask Luchii returned an on-topic 'Frasberg LINQ streaming and workspace platform' reply within ~15s; LINQ App tab embedded iframe with external open link; regression home/dashboard reachable.

issues: Page opens in 'Create account' (register) mode by default. Users landing here to sign in must click 'Already have an account? Sign in'. Consider defaulting to sign-in when redirected from a protected page (e.g., /linq -> Sign in gate should navigate to /auth?mode=login).
Hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> (React dev warning, non-blocking) seen in Hero/Dashboard render trees.

action_items: (Optional) Default /auth to sign-in mode when the user was redirected from an auth-gated page, or add ?mode=login support so the LINQ Sign in button lands directly on the login form.
(Optional) Fix hydration warning about <span> inside <option> in Hero component select dropdowns.
critical_code_review_comments: realtime_core.py: /rooms/tip endpoint accepts raw dict (bypasses Pydantic). Fine but consider a proper model. TipBody is defined but unused.
realtime_core.py: /agents/luchii/actions expects 'from' at top level (not in AgentActionBody model). Model exists but is unused; endpoint uses raw dict. Consistency issue but works.

linq_governance.py: _extract_json uses greedy regex \{.*\} which can misparse nested JSON with trailing prose. Works for well-behaved LLM output but fragile. Consider using json.JSONDecoder raw_decode.
linq_governance.py: MongoClient instantiated at module import (also duplicated in realtime_core.py). Consider centralized DB connection to avoid multiple pools.
Both routers: no rate limiting on expensive AI endpoints (/linq/layers/{n}/run, /engines/{engine}/run, /agents/luchii/actions) — abusable by any authenticated user.
linq_governance.py: run_layer/run_engine store AI-generated data as-is without validating required fields (tag/narrative/etc). If LLM returns partial JSON, artifacts may be missing fields.
